neighbours.label: the word 'both' ('Both groups', 'with both Paris and Madrid'), as against 'each', 'either', 'the two' in the same frames
fire: The trial compared two vaccines, and both produced strong immunity.
She speaks fluent French and also enjoys both opera and jazz.
Two candidates reached the final round. Both gave excellent speeches.
The treaty angered leaders in both Vienna and Rome.
The coach praised the defenders, since both had played through injuries.
Solar and wind power are growing fast. Both are now cheaper than coal.
The recipe works well with both fresh and frozen berries.
My parents grew up on farms, and both still love gardening.
quiet: The trial compared two vaccines, and each produced strong immunity.
She speaks fluent French and also enjoys opera as well as jazz.
Two candidates reached the final round. Each gave an excellent speech.
The treaty angered leaders in Vienna and in Rome.
The coach praised the defenders, since the two had played through injuries.
Solar and wind power are growing fast. They are now cheaper than coal.
The recipe works well with either fresh or frozen berries.
My parents grew up on farms, and they still love gardening.
